text: Spain won UEFA Euro 2024, defeating England 2-1 in the final in Berlin on 14 July 2024.
Argentina won the 2024 Copa America, beating Colombia 1-0 after extra time in the final in Miami.
Real Madrid won the 2023-24 UEFA Champions League, beating Borussia Dortmund 2-0 at Wembley Stadium.
Paris Saint-Germain won the 2024-25 UEFA Champions League, beating Inter Milan 5-0 in the final in Munich.
The Kansas City Chiefs won Super Bowl LVIII in February 2024, defeating the San Francisco 49ers in overtime.
The Philadelphia Eagles won Super Bowl LIX in February 2025, defeating the Kansas City Chiefs.
The 2024 Summer Olympics were held in Paris, France, from 26 July to 11 August 2024.
The United States finished top of the medal table at the 2024 Paris Olympics.
Carlos Alcaraz won the 2024 Wimbledon men's singles title, defeating Novak Djokovic in the final.
Carlos Alcaraz won the 2024 French Open men's singles title, his first at Roland Garros.
Jannik Sinner won the 2024 Australian Open men's singles title, his first Grand Slam.
Jannik Sinner won the 2024 US Open men's singles title.
Iga Swiatek won the 2024 French Open women's singles title.
Aryna Sabalenka won the 2024 US Open women's singles title.
Barbora Krejcikova won the 2024 Wimbledon women's singles title.
The Los Angeles Dodgers won the 2024 World Series, defeating the New York Yankees in five games.
The Boston Celtics won the 2024 NBA Finals, their record 18th championship.
The Oklahoma City Thunder won the 2025 NBA Finals, defeating the Indiana Pacers in seven games.
The Florida Panthers won their first Stanley Cup in 2024.
The Florida Panthers won the Stanley Cup again in 2025, defeating the Edmonton Oilers.
Max Verstappen won the 2024 Formula 1 World Drivers' Championship, his fourth consecutive title.
Tadej Pogacar won the 2024 Tour de France.
Tadej Pogacar won the 2024 UCI Road World Championship road race, completing a Giro-Tour-Worlds treble in one season.
Tadej Pogacar won the 2025 Tour de France.
Real Madrid signed Kylian Mbappe on a free transfer from Paris Saint-Germain in 2024.
Manchester City won the 2023-24 Premier League title, a record fourth consecutive English top-flight title.
Liverpool won the 2024-25 Premier League title under manager Arne Slot.
Italy won the 2024 Davis Cup, retaining the title.
Real Madrid won the 2023-24 Spanish La Liga title.
Barcelona won the 2024-25 Spanish La Liga title.
Lamine Yamal, aged 16, became the youngest player to score at a European Championship at Euro 2024.
Rodri of Manchester City and Spain won the 2024 Ballon d'Or.
Aitana Bonmati won the 2024 women's Ballon d'Or.
Caitlin Clark was the first overall pick in the 2024 WNBA draft, selected by the Indiana Fever.
The New York Liberty won their first WNBA championship in 2024.
Shohei Ohtani became the first MLB player to record 50 home runs and 50 stolen bases in a single season, in 2024.
Scottie Scheffler won the 2024 Masters Tournament.
Rory McIlroy won the 2025 Masters Tournament, completing the career Grand Slam.
Jannik Sinner won the 2025 Australian Open men's singles title, defeating Alexander Zverev.
Madison Keys won the 2025 Australian Open women's singles title.
Carlos Alcaraz won the 2025 French Open men's singles title, defeating Jannik Sinner in the final.
Coco Gauff won the 2025 French Open women's singles title.
Jannik Sinner won the 2025 Wimbledon men's singles title, defeating Carlos Alcaraz.
Iga Swiatek won the 2025 Wimbledon women's singles title, winning the final 6-0, 6-0.
Carlos Alcaraz won the 2025 US Open men's singles title.
Aryna Sabalenka won the 2025 US Open women's singles title.
Chelsea won the 2025 FIFA Club World Cup, defeating Paris Saint-Germain in the final.
Crystal Palace won the 2025 FA Cup, defeating Manchester City in the final.
Scottie Scheffler won the 2025 Open Championship at Royal Portrush.
Leon Marchand won four individual swimming gold medals for France at the 2024 Paris Olympics.
Donald Trump won the 2024 United States presidential election, defeating Kamala Harris.
Donald Trump was inaugurated as the 47th President of the United States on 20 January 2025.
JD Vance became Vice President of the United States in January 2025.
Joe Biden withdrew from the 2024 US presidential race in July 2024 and endorsed Kamala Harris.
Kamala Harris became the 2024 Democratic presidential nominee.
The Labour Party won the 2024 United Kingdom general election, and Keir Starmer became Prime Minister.
Claudia Sheinbaum was elected President of Mexico in 2024, the first woman to hold the office.
Narendra Modi began a third consecutive term as Prime Minister of India after the 2024 general election.
The African National Congress lost its parliamentary majority in South Africa's 2024 election for the first time since 1994.
Prabowo Subianto won Indonesia's 2024 presidential election.
Iran's President Ebrahim Raisi died in a helicopter crash in May 2024.
Masoud Pezeshkian was elected President of Iran in July 2024.
The government of Bashar al-Assad collapsed in December 2024, ending Assad family rule in Syria.
Sweden joined NATO in March 2024 as its 32nd member.
Mark Rutte became Secretary General of NATO in October 2024.
Friedrich Merz became Chancellor of Germany in May 2025 following the February 2025 federal election.
Mark Carney became Prime Minister of Canada in 2025 after Justin Trudeau resigned as Liberal leader.
Pope Francis died in April 2025.
Cardinal Robert Prevost was elected Pope Leo XIV in May 2025, becoming the first pope born in the United States.
South Korean President Yoon Suk Yeol briefly declared martial law in December 2024 before parliament overturned it.
Sheikh Hasina resigned and fled Bangladesh in August 2024 amid mass protests.
The European Parliament elections were held across the EU in June 2024.
France held snap legislative elections in 2024 that produced a hung parliament.
Ursula von der Leyen was re-elected President of the European Commission in 2024.
Donald Trump survived an assassination attempt at a rally in Butler, Pennsylvania, in July 2024.
Antonio Costa became President of the European Council in December 2024.
South Korea's Constitutional Court removed Yoon Suk Yeol from the presidency in 2025.
Nicolas Maduro claimed victory in Venezuela's disputed July 2024 presidential election amid opposition challenges.

A total solar eclipse crossed North America on 8 April 2024.
NASA launched the Europa Clipper spacecraft toward Jupiter's moon Europa in October 2024.
SpaceX caught a returning Super Heavy booster with the launch tower's mechanical arms for the first time in October 2024.
The Polaris Dawn mission carried out the first commercial spacewalk in September 2024.
Boeing's Starliner spacecraft returned to Earth uncrewed in September 2024, leaving its two test astronauts on the ISS.
NASA astronauts Butch Wilmore and Suni Williams returned from an extended ISS stay aboard a SpaceX Dragon in 2025.
The 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics was awarded to John Hopfield and Geoffrey Hinton for work on machine learning with neural networks.
The 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry was awarded to David Baker, Demis Hassabis and John Jumper for protein structure prediction.
The 2024 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine was awarded to Victor Ambros and Gary Ruvkun for the discovery of microRNA.
The 2024 Nobel Prize in Literature was awarded to South Korean author Han Kang.

OpenAI released the GPT-4o model in May 2024.
Anthropic released Claude 3.5 Sonnet in June 2024.

Google introduced its Gemini 2.0 models in December 2024.
Intuitive Machines' Odysseus lander became the first US spacecraft to land on the Moon since 1972, in February 2024.
China's Chang'e 6 mission returned the first samples from the far side of the Moon in June 2024.
The 2025 Nobel Peace Prize was awarded to Venezuelan opposition leader Maria Corina Machado.
The 2025 Nobel Prize in Literature was awarded to Hungarian author Laszlo Krasznahorkai.
OpenAI released GPT-5 in August 2025.
The H5N1 bird flu spread to dairy cattle in the United States during 2024, with some human cases reported.

Apple released its Vision Pro headset in the United States in February 2024.
Apple released the iPhone 16 in September 2024.

Google DeepMind unveiled AlphaFold 3 in May 2024.
China launched the Shenzhou 19 crewed mission to its Tiangong space station in October 2024.
Oppenheimer won Best Picture at the 96th Academy Awards in March 2024.
Cillian Murphy won the Academy Award for Best Actor for Oppenheimer in 2024.
Emma Stone won the Academy Award for Best Actress for Poor Things in 2024.
Robert Downey Jr. won the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor for Oppenheimer in 2024.
Anora won Best Picture at the 97th Academy Awards in March 2025.
Mikey Madison won the Academy Award for Best Actress for Anora in 2025.
Adrien Brody won the Academy Award for Best Actor for The Brutalist in 2025.
Taylor Swift released the album The Tortured Poets Department in April 2024.
Taylor Swift's Eras Tour concluded in December 2024 in Vancouver.
Beyonce released the album Cowboy Carter in March 2024.
Beyonce's Cowboy Carter won Album of the Year at the 2025 Grammy Awards.
Inside Out 2 became the highest-grossing animated film of all time in 2024.
Dune: Part Two was released in March 2024.
Deadpool & Wolverine was released in July 2024.
Kendrick Lamar's song Not Like Us was a major hit in 2024 amid his feud with Drake.
Kendrick Lamar performed at the Super Bowl LIX halftime show in February 2025.
Charli XCX released the album Brat in June 2024, defining a cultural brat summer.
The action game Black Myth: Wukong was released in August 2024.
Astro Bot won Game of the Year at The Game Awards 2024.

The second season of Squid Game was released on Netflix in December 2024.
The film Wicked, the first of two parts, was released in November 2024.
Taylor Swift's album Midnights won Album of the Year at the 2024 Grammy Awards.
A Minecraft Movie was a major box-office success after its release in 2025.
The animated film KPop Demon Hunters became one of Netflix's most-watched films in 2025.
Jimmy Carter, the 39th US President, died on 29 December 2024 at the age of 100.
Russian opposition leader Alexei Navalny died in an Arctic penal colony in February 2024.
O.J. Simpson died in April 2024.
Actor James Earl Jones died in September 2024.
Actress Maggie Smith died in September 2024.
Music producer Quincy Jones died in November 2024.
Former One Direction member Liam Payne died in October 2024.
Actor Gene Hackman died in February 2025.
Filmmaker David Lynch died in January 2025.
Musician Ozzy Osbourne died in July 2025.
Sex therapist and media personality Dr. Ruth Westheimer died in July 2024.

Bitcoin's price surpassed 100,000 US dollars for the first time in December 2024.
The United States imposed broad new tariffs on imports in April 2025 under President Trump.
A US law forced a brief shutdown of TikTok in January 2025 before service was restored.
